subject: Aegis Health demo — reblock requested to include governance reviewers
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stanton <emily.stanton@aegishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Aegis Health — intro demo and proposed times

Hi Emily — great to connect earlier. As discussed, we pulled together a 45-minute walk-through focused on latency, cost controls, and governance for your clinical-data use cases. Draft agenda attached (Aegis-demo-agenda-v1.pdf).

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–10:45
- Wed May 12, 14:00–14:45
- Thu May 13, 09:00–09:45

Ben (cc) will run the demo and cover architecture + routing policies. If you have a preferred time above, or different stakeholders to include, let us know and we’ll lock it in.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
From: Emily Stanton <emily.stanton@aegishealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@aegishealth.com>, Aegis Procurement <procurement@aegishealth.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aegis Health — intro demo and proposed times

Thanks Priya — we’re excited. Quick update from our side: the governance and procurement teams want to join the initial run. Ravi (Security) will need a short SOC2/retention overview and procurement asked for a checklist they can use when evaluating contracts.

Can we expand the session to 60 minutes and move to next week? Our earliest availability with the added folks is Tue May 18 or Wed May 19 in the morning. Apologies for the late notice — traveling and calendar conflicts this week.

Emily
Emily Stanton
Director, Product Integrations | Aegis Health
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stanton <emily.stanton@aegishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aegis Health — intro demo and proposed times

Thanks for the heads-up, Emily — totally makes sense to include governance and procurement on the first pass. Two quick asks so we make the session useful:
1) Can you confirm the primary focus for Ravi (security) — SOC2 scope, data residency, or network topology?
2) Are there any procurement items they want us to prepare (SLA examples, sample contract language, or pricing band)?

Ben — can you expand the deck to 60 minutes and add a short SOC2/retention slide? Vivek, if we’re covering routing/capacity/infra constraints, would you be able to join for the Q&A?

I’ll tentatively propose Tue May 18 09:30–10:30 PDT and Wed May 19 09:30–10:30 PDT and hold both until Emily confirms. Attaching a one-page SOC2 summary for quick review (SOC2-summary-for-aegis.xlsx).

— Priya
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aegis Health — intro demo and proposed times

Copy — I’ll rework the walkthrough to 60 minutes and add the governance/procurement slide. Vivek — if you can take the infra Q&A (15–20 mins) that leaves ~35 mins for product + roadmap.

I also suggest we prepare a short mutual action plan (MAP) to send ahead of the call so procurement has a clear list of next steps (security questionnaire, contract owner, expected timelines). I can draft and share in the thread.

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aegis Health — intro demo and proposed times

I can join either May 18 or 19 morning. Two notes from infra perspective:
- Recommend scheduling a 75-minute slot instead of 60 so we have time for architecture deep-dive if they push on multi-region / private deployment options.
- If Ravi needs network diagrams or an HSM/KMS slide, tell me now so I can pull diagrams and coordinate with infra docs.

Steph — pinging you for approval on the extra time; we may need to reassign other demos that morning.

Vivek
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aegis Health — intro demo and proposed times

Thanks team — approved to push to a 75-minute session for Aegis given procurement+security presence. Priya: please confirm with Emily which of the two dates they prefer and lock the call in. Ben/Vivek: Ben — please send the MAP and updated agenda; Vivek — attach the infra diagram and note any follow-ups.

If we move other bookings, put a short note in the calendar invite so stakeholders know why the longer slot was granted.

— Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
